title: Watch Me Dead
description: Allows you to look around freely with your mouse on the death screen while holding alt and removes the red background overlay by default.
body:
![bg](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/ERoXyLI1/images/d5ebde2c482386305bf53656275a2d4dfdbf6dab.gif)

[Aquarius Libs](https://modrinth.com/mod/aquarius-libs) needs to be installed for this mod to work!

This **client-side** mod allows you to look around freely with your mouse on the death screen while **holding alt** and removes the red background overlay by default.

  ---

What it does

**Automatic Rotation:** The camera slowly rotates around your body automatically instead of staying frozen in place

**Hold Alt to Look Around (Free Look):** Holding the Left Alt key pauses the automatic rotation, allowing you to manually look around using your mouse. This action also completely hides all menu buttons for an unblocked view.

**Dynamic Zoom Controls:** You can scroll your mouse wheel to zoom in and out. To keep your viewing angles steady, the camera's rotation speed slows down automatically the further you zoom in.

**No Disappearing Mobs:** Nearby monsters and creatures stay visible on your screen instead of vanishing. They won't move around though.

**Removed Red Background:** The standard reddish death screen overlay is totally gone, giving you a normal, clear view of the world.

**Config option:** red background visibility, hide entities after death, auto rotate speed, mouse free-look speed, zoom smoothness.
 
 ---

Supported Versions
- **Loaders:** Forge, Fabric, and NeoForge.
- **Versions:** 26.1.x
- _Note: No plans to support older versions below 26.1 for now!_

 ---

Found a Bug?
If you encounter any **bugs** or experience a **crash**, please **send** the **crash log** directly to me via **[curseforge private message](https://legacy.curseforge.com/members/aleni26/projects)** so I can look into it.
